title: builtin.action.move_to parameters
description: Moves toward the entity stored in a blackboard key, at a fixed speed. Running while the target is farther than arrival_radius_m, Success inside it. Fails if the key is unset or the entity is not a current contact.

target_key.description: Blackboard key of type entity that holds the target (read only).

speed_mps.description: Cruise speed in meters per second (the motion model clamps it to its limits).

arrival_radius_m.description: Distance in meters at or below which the action succeeds.
